neighbours.label: the word closing the hedge 'Unless I'm ⟦mistaken/wrong⟧', and nouns naming the web medium one is reading or its apparatus (the ⟦browser⟧, this ⟦forum⟧, the ⟦article⟧ on Wikipedia)
fire: Unless I'm mistaken, that church was rebuilt after the fire.
Unless I'm wrong, we already paid that invoice in March.
The meeting, unless I'm mistaken, was moved to Thursday.
Unless I'm wrong, his sister still lives in Leeds.
If the browser has JavaScript turned off, the menu will not open.
When the browser is closed, all saved tabs are lost.
As the article on Wikipedia notes, the canal was never finished.
If the browser is out of date, the video may not play.
quiet: As far as I know, that church was rebuilt after the fire.
I believe we already paid that invoice in March.
The meeting, as I recall, was moved to Thursday.
I think his sister still lives in Leeds.
If the oven has the timer turned off, the alarm will not sound.
When the window is closed, all the street noise is lost.
As the plaque on the wall notes, the canal was never finished.
If the milk is out of date, the sauce may not thicken.

notes: A list, not a distinction: I could not find the shared pattern behind 'browser', 'mistaken', 'questions on this site', 'viewers', 'authors'. Weak pole (probes 0.2-0.32 of max; 1% of tokens reach 0.1).
